dataset.name: Luxembourg road user charge (Eurovignette, droit d'usage)
dataset.method: Loi modifiée du 24 février 1995 (Eurovignette Agreement of 9 February 1994); Règlement grand-ducal du 21 mai 2019, art. 1er, 4° as published: the daily charge, administrative costs included, is 12 euros for every category of vehicle from 1 July 2019, for goods vehicles of 12 t or more. Replaced on 25 March 2025 by the amounts by CO2 class (RGD of 18 December 2024).
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: RGD du 21 mai 2019, as published (Legilux, Mémorial A 353)
Guichet.lu: Eurovignette, droit d'usage routier pour poids-lourds (a day's charge is a calendar day, 00:00 to 24:00)

vehicles.description: Goods vehicles of 12 t or more maximum mass

network.description: The motorways and similar roads in the RGD's annex.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
